'''Kai Zykken''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who was captain of the [[Corellian Run Scoundrels]], a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] gang during the [[Galactic War]].<ref name="A Scoundrel's Debt" /> A persistent rumor was that Zykken once kidnapped the [[Viril Shu's daughter|adult daughter]] of [[Viril Shu]], a corporate magnate on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Denon/Legends|Denon]]. Rather than ransom her, Zyyken unsuccessfully attempted to woo her into marrying him, thus allowing Zykken access to Shu's fortune.<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=codex|Corellian Run Scoundrels}}</ref> Zykken ran the Scoundrels on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] with his [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] lieutenant [[Tomota]]. Later, he would go on to visit the [[planet]] of [[Odessen]] following the establishment of the [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]], whereupon he would celebrate in a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] along with the members of the organization.

Around [[3622 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|7.6.1}} 7.6.1: Rising Powers can be placed around [[3622 BBY]].</ref> Zykken established an uplink with the [[Alliance Commander]] and told the Commander that he had done some informal consulting for [[Czerka Interstellar]] and required assistance in testing a [[Czerka Phase Three Adrenal Combat Enhancers|new combat boost]] that the Czerka developed.<ref name="Research and Destruction">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=event|Galactic Season 8: Research and Destruction}}</ref> Later on [[Standard year/Legends|that year]], after becoming Czerka's [[Vice President/Legends|Vice President]] of [[Combat Enhancement Synergy]], Zykken established another uplink with the Commander to test [[Czerka Experimental Combat Enhancer Mk. 2|another top-grade combat stims]] created by the Czerka, which he described as the most stable stims anyone in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] had ever seen.<ref name="Trial by Firepower" /> 

==Behind the scenes==
Kai Zykken first appeared as part of the mission "A Scoundrel's Debt" from ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan|Shadow of Revan]]'', a [[2014]] expansion to the [[2011]] [[Roleplaying game|massively-multiplayer online roleplaying]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.

Zykken made a cameo in the [[2015]] expansion ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire|Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' during a cantina cutscene.<ref name="Chapter 9">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=9}}</ref> With the release of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught]]'' in [[2019]], Zykken was added to the [[Carrick Station|Republic fleet]] and the [[Vaiken Spacedock|Imperial fleet]] as a "Merchant of Mystery," selling endgame armor to players.<ref name="Onslaught fleet">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught]]''</ref> However, he is later replaced by [[S3T-BNS]].<ref name="Lots fleet">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]''</ref>

Players of any gender aligned with either faction may choose to flirt with Kai Zykken during the opening conversations of the "A Scoundrel's Debt" mission. Zykken initially seems interested, but ultimately turns down the player.<ref name="A Scoundrel's Debt" />
